model.name: R19.84: Drawer grab-handle drag-resizes height between min and 95vh.
model.description: The drawer grab handle must drag the drawer height in real time (touchmove sets height). Clamp between 120px min and 95vh max. Swipe-dismiss preserved off-handle (body swipe-down > 80px closes). Currently swipe-dismiss only, no resize.
model.tronQuote: > TRON: drawer nudge must drag-resize height, not just dismiss
